title: Fourier observation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, let $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ be finite, and let $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$. The Fourier observation of $f$ at $x$ on $S$ is $f(x)\prod_{i\in S}x_i$.
